evaluator.value: function value(v,state){if(v.type==="VARIABLE_ALIAS")return state[v.value.id];if(v.type!=="EXPRESSION")return v.value;const e=v.value,a=e.expressionArguments.map(x=>value(x,state));switch(e.expressionFunction){case"EQUALS":return a[0]===a[1];case"NOT_EQUAL":return a[0]!==a[1];case"AND":return a.every(Boolean);case"LESS_THAN":return a[0]<a[1];case"GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL":return a[0]>=a[1];case"ADDITION":return a[0]+a[1];default:throw Error(e.expressionFunction)}}
evaluator.run: function run(id,state={},timeout){const st={...state},events=[];function actions(arr){for(const a of arr){if(a.type==="SET_VARIABLE")st[a.variableId]=value(a.variableValue,st);else if(a.type==="CONDITIONAL"){for(const b of a.conditionalBlocks)if(!b.condition||value(b.condition,st)){actions(b.actions);break}}else events.push(a)}}for(const r of by[id].reactions||[])if(timeout===undefined||Math.abs((r.trigger.timeout||0)-timeout)<.001)actions(r.actions);return{state:st,events}}
